description: Expected schema-rejection reason for every negative fixture in this directory. Kept in a side manifest because the baseline schema is additionalProperties:false everywhere and tolerates no annotation fields inside instances. Completeness (every fixture has an entry and vice versa) is enforced by crates/pointlock-ir/tests/behavioral_equivalence.rs.

cases.act_chain_vision_channel.json: BoundAttempt.channel is ActChannel (dom|uiTree|coordinate); 'vision' never locates or acts (02 §5.1, principle 7).
cases.assert_step_empty_assertions.json: AssertStepIR.assertions has minItems 1 — an assertion-free assert step is meaningless (02 §4.2).
cases.empty_attempts.json: ActionBinding.attempts has minItems 1 — an act-chain is never empty (02 §5.1).
cases.error_classes_on_wrong_hook.json: HandlerBinding.errorClasses is legal only when hook == 'onError' (02 §10).
An 'expr' predicate forces verifyVia == []: pure output assertions consume no observation channel (02 §5.3).
cases.human_on_timeout_not_unknown.json: HumanStepIR.onTimeout is const 'unknown' — a timed-out human step never defaults to pass or fail (02 §4.4, principle 4).
cases.invalid_hash_format.json: Hash grammar is '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'; uppercase hex violates the canonical single representation (02 §12).
cases.ir_version_2.json: irVersion is const 1 in v0.1; runners match exactly and fail closed (02 §11).
cases.missing_checkpoint.json: StepBase.checkpoint is required — sealed IR materializes all defaulted fields (single-representation rule, 02 §2.4).
cases.on_missing_input_not_unknown.json: AssertionIR.onMissingInput is const 'unknown' — a channel that cannot answer never guesses (02 §5.3, principle 4).
cases.protection_protected.json: BoundAttempt.protection is const 'standard' in v0.1; protected actions are rejected at bind (02 §5.1 rule 7, spine R6).
cases.provide_input_missing_output_schema.json: mode 'provideInput' requires outputSchema — the human's answer is the step output and must have a contract (02 §4.4).
cases.purefn_arity_mismatch.json: PureFn 'not' takes exactly one argument; FnExpr arity is schema-enforced (02 §8.2).
cases.ref_scope_out_of_bounds.json: RefPath's scope grammar is closed to params/env/vars/iter/steps; 'secrets.*' is reserved for v0.2 and rejected today (02 §8.1).
cases.step_unknown_field.json: Step objects are closed (unevaluatedProperties:false over the StepBase composition); unknown fields are rejected (02 §2.2/§2.3).
cases.verify_chain_coordinate.json: AssertionIR.verifyVia items are VerifyChannel (dom|uiTree|vision); a coordinate cannot verify anything (02 §5.3).
cases.visual_predicate_non_vision_chain.json: A 'visual' predicate forces verifyVia == ["vision"]: only vision can answer a visual question (02 §5.3).
